In this study, bulk recombination has the largest impact on efficiency.
A large operating potential offset is strongly associated with reduced performance when mobile ions are introduced.
Higher ion concentration is not necessarily associated with degraded cell parameters, contrary to common expectation.
The finding that mobile ions minimally impact high-efficiency cells conflicts with received wisdom that ions drive degradation.
